1. 选择或新增端点，配置参数后点击「连接 / 监听」。多个端点可同时保持在线。:
1. Select or create an endpoint, configure its parameters and click Connect / Listen. Multiple endpoints can stay online.
2. TCP Server sends to the selected client. UDP uses the remote host / port and accepts data from any source.
3. Text uses UTF-8; HEX accepts two-digit bytes separated by whitespace. Ctrl+Enter sends. Periodic sending keeps the session, target and data selected at start.
4. Traffic retains the latest 1,000 records. Pausing affects display only. Export saves retained records matching the current filter. Select a row to view its complete payload in Packet details.
5. TCP / Serial rows are received chunks, not protocol frame boundaries. Settings are stored in LocalAppData. Endpoints are never started automatically.
6. Modbus master, slave and register tables are available in the Modbus tab.
